description: After making their attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: TM90
description: The user makes a copy of themselves using some of their HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.

name: TM91
description: The user gathers all their light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TM92
description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

name: TM93
description: The user is shrouded in electricity and smashes into the target. It also damages the user a little.

name: TM94
description: The additional effects of this attack depend upon where it was used.

name: TM95
description: The user yells as if they are ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stat of opposing Pokémon.

name: TM96
description: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects vary depending on the user's environment.

name: TM97
description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

name: TM98
description: Striking opponents over and over makes the user's fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.

name: TM99
description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

name: TMX1
description: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. This can also be used to cut down thin trees.

name: TMX2
description: The user soars and then strikes their target on the next turn. This can also be used to fly to any familiar town.

name: TMX3
description: The user swamps their surroundings with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

name: TMX4
description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. This can also be used to move heavy boulders.

name: TMX5
description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. This can also be used to climb a waterfall.

name: TMX6
description: Dives on the first turn and floats up and attacks on the next turn. Can be used to dive deep in the ocean.

name: TMX7
description: The user attacks with a punch which may lower the target's Defense stat. It can also shatter rocks in the field.

name: TMX8
description: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target's Accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate dark caves.

name: TMX9
description: Smashes into the target with great force. May confuse the target. Can be used to scale rocky walls.

name: Town Map
description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows you your present location in the region.

name: Toxic Orb
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a bizarre orb that will badly poison the holder during battle.

name: Toxic Plate
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a stone tablet that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.

name: Tunnel Mail
description: Stationery featuring a print of a dimly lit coal mine. Let a Pokémon hold it for delivery.

name: Twisted Spoon
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This spoon is imbued with telekinetic power and boosts Psychic-type moves.

name: Tyranitarite
description: Have Tyranitar hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.

name: Ultra Ball
description: An ultra-high-performance Poké Ball that provides a higher success rate for catching Pokémon than a Great Ball.

name: Ultra Potion
description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 200 HP to an injured Pokémon.

name: Ultranecrozium-Z
description: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Ultra Necrozma's Photon Geyser to a Z-Move.

name: Up-Grade
description: A transparent device somehow filled with all sorts of data. It was produced by Silph Co.

name: Utility Umbrella
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This sturdy umbrella protects the holder from the effects of weather.

name: Vanilla Ice Cream
description: A vanilla flavored treat! Eat it before it melts to restore 30 HP!

name: Venusaurite
description: Have Venusaur hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.

name: Wacan Berry
description: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will lessen the damage taken from one supereffective Electric-type attack.

name: Wailmer Pail
description: This is a tool for watering Berries you planted to make them grow more quickly.

name: Warehouse Key
description: An old key marked for an unknown warehouse.

name: Water Gem
description: A gem with an essence of water. When held, it strengthens the power of a Water-type move one time.

name: Water Memory
description: A memory disc that contains Water-type data. It changes the type of the holder if held by a certain Pokémon.

name: Water Stone
description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is the blue of a pool of clear water.

name: Waterium-Z
description: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Water-type moves to Z-Moves.

name: Watmel Berry
description: Used to make Pokéblocks that will enhance your Cleverness, this Berry is rare in most regions.

name: Wave Incense
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This incense has a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

name: Weakness Policy
description: To be held by a Pokémon. Attack and Sp. Atk sharply increase if the holder is hit with a move they're weak to.

name: Wepear Berry
description: Used to make Pokéblocks that will enhance your Cleverness. Its green flesh is bitter when eaten.

name: Whipped Dream
description: A soft and sweet treat made of fluffy, puffy, whipped and whirled cream. It's loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: White Apricorn
description: A white Apricorn. It doesn't smell like anything.

name: White Flute
description: A white flute made from blown glass. Its melody makes wild Pokémon more likely to appear.

name: White Herb
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle. It can be used only once.

name: Wide Lens
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the Accuracy of moves.

name: Wiki Berry
description: If held by a Pokémon, it restores the user's HP in a pinch, but it will cause confusion if the user hates the taste.

name: Wise Glasses
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This thick pair of glasses slightly boosts the power of special moves.

name: Wishing Piece
description: Throw one into a Pokémon Den to attract a wild Rift Pokémon.

name: X Accuracy
description: Sharply boosts the Accuracy of a Pokémon during battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Attack
description: Sharply boosts the Attack stat of a Pokémon during battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Defend
description: Sharply boosts the Defense stat of a Pokémon during battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Sp. Atk
description: Sharply boosts the Sp. Atk stat of a Pokémon during battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Sp. Def
description: Sharply boosts the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon during battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Speed
description: Sharply boosts the Speed stat of a Pokémon during battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: Yache Berry
description: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will lessen the damage taken from one supereffective Ice-type attack.

name: Yellow Apricorn
description: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.

name: Yellow Flute
description: A flute made from yellow glass that snaps Pokémon out of confusion.

name: Yellow Nectar
description: A flower nectar imported from Melemele Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.

name: Yellow Scarf
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Gives its holder a tougher demeanor.

name: Yureyu Key
description: A key marked with Yureyu's logo. What could it go to?

name: Zap Plate
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It's a stone tablet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

name: Zinc
description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the base Sp. Def stat of a single Pokémon.

name: Zoom Lens
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder moves after their target moves, their Accuracy will be boosted.
